title: chrysanthemum leucanthemum subsp. maximum
intro: Chrysanthemum leucanthemum subsp. maximum, commonly known as Maxim's Oxeye Daisy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family. This perennial herb is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral activities. The health benefits of Maxim's Oxeye Daisy include reducing fever, relieving digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which work together to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
